dashboard.label: Windows Security Monitoring Dashboard
dashboard.description: Windows Server security monitoring using Windows Event Logs and Sysmon

search.query: index=windows_event_logs sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" earliest=-24h | stats count AS "Total Security Events"
index=windows_event_logs sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 earliest=-24h | stats count AS "Failed Logons"
index=windows_event_logs sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4624 earliest=-24h | stats count AS "Successful Logons"
index=sysmon_logs earliest=-24h | stats count AS "Sysmon Events"

index=windows_event_logs sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=4625) earliest=-24h | eval Result=case(EventCode=4624,"Successful",EventCode=4625,"Failed") | stats count by Result
index=windows_event_logs sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 earliest=-24h | timechart span=1h count AS failed_logons | where failed_logons > 0

chart.title: Top Accounts Targeted by Failed Logons

search.query: index=windows_event_logs sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 earliest=-24h | rex field=Message "(?s)Account For Which Logon Failed:.*?Account Name:\s+(?<target_account>[^\r\n]+)" | eval account=coalesce(target_account,TargetUserName,Account_Name) | where isnotnull(account) AND account!="-" | stats count AS failed_attempts by account | sort -failed_attempts | head 10

index=windows_event_logs sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=4625) earliest=-24h | rex field=Message "(?s)Logon Type:\s+(?<logon_type>\d+)" | eval Logon_Type=case( logon_type="2","Interactive", logon_type="3","Network", logon_type="4","Batch", logon_type="5","Service", logon_type="7","Unlock", logon_type="8","Network Cleartext", logon_type="9","New Credentials", logon_type="10","Remote Interactive (RDP)", logon_type="11","Cached Interactive", true(),"Other" ) | stats count by Logon_Type
index=sysmon_logs EventCode=1 earliest=-24h | where NOT like(Image,"%\\SplunkUniversalForwarder\\%") | stats count AS process_creations by Image | sort -process_creations | head 10
index=sysmon_logs EventCode=3 earliest=-24h | table _time host User Image SourceIp SourcePort DestinationIp DestinationPort Protocol Initiated | sort -_time | head 10
